newsitem.title: USA: Ohio governor appoints two to higher ed agency.
newsitem.headline: Ohio governor appoints two to higher ed agency.

text.p: - Ohio Gov. George Voinovich on Friday appointed Kenneth Kutina and Judy Baltimore to the state's Higher Educational Facility Commission.

Kutina, vice president of institutional planning and analysis with Case Western Reserve University, replaced Russel Peterson who resigned from the commission. Kutina's term on the commission ends Jan. 1 2004.
Baltimore, an administrator with the Warren R. Baltimore Co., was appointed to a term ending Jan 1, 2005.
